summary.scope: Archive closed three-level CAD fields or complete source/localization diagnostics without accepting physical convergence.

covered-contact-source-qualification-v1.scope: Reconstruct all covered-contact source forces and discrete surface components against complete independent audits.
covered-contact-source-qualification-v1.limitations: Original closed five-state force audits qualify each producer. Every current normal/friction stencil and full mapped force must match the independently audited arrays before source attribution. Selector maps permit exact standalone collision reconstruction without reassembling bulk elasticity. Every source force is retained; active surface components use actual triangle adjacency above1e-8N, with the complete below-threshold wrench explicit. These are discrete graph components and lumped force densities, not continuum contact islands, pressures or areas. Finite-gap friction moments remain measured outputs. No spatial/contact/geometry/regularization/model/feedback or warmed-cost acceptance follows.

covered-cad-contact-source-diagnostics-v.scope: Retain contact-template roles, density hotspots and matched source-wrench changes across covered CAD levels.
covered-cad-contact-source-diagnostics-v.limitations: Every original force, threshold tail and component remains in the qualified parent arrays. All nodes participate in density hotspots. Template support counts and actual stored weights distinguish body/finger vertex and edge roles; reaction interpolation on coarse rigid triangles can produce different lumped-density diagnostics without identifying a continuous pressure field. Force/moment differences are retained in physical units; the nonzero source-force norm normalizes its vector change. These diagnostics alone establish neither contact-pressure convergence nor a causal/additive split of bulk/geometry/contact/model errors.

covered-cad-tensor-change-localization-v.scope: Partition every covered-CAD probe's tensor change by distance to original contact samples.
covered-cad-tensor-change-localization-v.limitations: Five interior probes per seed tetrahedron retain their original seed-volume diagnostic weights; this is not exact cross-mesh continuum integration. Distance is measured in shared reference coordinates to the union of every nonzero body normal-force sample on the two compared meshes, not to a continuous contact boundary or a current finger edge. Source proximity does not assign mechanical causation. No probes, near-contact region or raw global maxima are removed. Every complete norm is reproduced before partitioning. Bulk, geometry and contact discretization remain coupled; localization alone proves neither singularity nor physical convergence, contact-model accuracy, feedback or warmed application cost.

limitations: All15 original covered-CAD dynamic source states retain complete normal/shear stencil forces, full pullback, source/counterbody six-component wrenches, actual graph components, complete threshold tails and all-node force-density diagnostics. The same measured6mm finger crease has90-degree incident face planes; this and density growth do not prove a continuum singularity or continuous pressure convergence. Both158340-probe complete tensor norms reproduce before every distance/hydrostatic/deviatoric partition; no probe lies within25um of the original normal-sample clouds. Seed-volume probe weights are diagnostic, not exact cross-mesh integration. Actual native31668/64716-tet full-inertia/rigid-relief replays pass unchanged gates but remain conditional model diagnostics. Both contact-distance preparation runs generate zero physical states; actual dependent controls remain unaccepted here. Editable figures retain real render failure and accepted preview/SVG/PDF/1000dpi PNG. Every original physical/model/island/history/application/feedback and warmed accuracy/cost gate remains open. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
